content.content:
Applies to the six recorded edges, one prerequisite at a time: read the dependent against each prerequisite in depends_on and apply both criteria to that edge. The evaluation is satisfied only when all six edges pass.

1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it departs from. A scoping clause in the dependent — one that says where something lives, which invocation acts, or which working copy carries the work — contradicts when it re-places, renames or duplicates something the prerequisite fixes, or when it holds only under a reading of the prerequisite that the prerequisite does not state. Which element is at issue is what the check discovers at check time; nothing is pre-named by this criterion.

2. Edge use: in the dependent, find the element whose soundness this prerequisite carries. Fail naming the prerequisite when the dependent contains no such element; an unused recorded edge is a finding, not a licence.
content.rationale:
All six recorded prerequisites are inline prose and so is the dependent, so every edge falls in the natural-to-natural cell and takes that cell's licence check as its criterion, applied once per recorded prerequisite in turn at check time. A prose child is a commitment in words, not behaviour, and a behaviour probe belongs to a cell whose child is code: there is nothing to run here, the unit claims no repository path, and the check is decided by reading the recorded documents against one another.

Criterion 2 exists because one evaluation carries the coverage of six recorded edges. An evaluation gates the dependent's use of a prerequisite, not the mere absence of a clash with a prerequisite the dependent never reaches; without it an edge the dependent does not use would pass vacuously. Which element fails, and against which prerequisite, is the check's output, not part of either criterion.

What the marker-file parent carries. ysqqrqsp fixes the marker file as one path: `.deccy/markers.json`, in the deccy state directory under the store root, untracked with the state directory. That is the answer to where the stack is, so a dependent naming another file, another directory or another root departs from it, and a dependent that reaches the stack by moving it departs by construction. The place is also why the trunk can be named without a second placement: the repository root is itself a working copy and the state directory is a directory of it, which is exactly why a checkout of the same tree cannot be put there and draft workspaces live outside the repository (xqzstoyo). So the trunk workspace, where the dependent places the stack, is the working copy that holds the store root and nothing else; a dependent that made the stack per-workspace, or that let a draft workspace carry a stack of its own, would be designing a second marker file and criterion 1 would name it against ysqqrqsp.

What the bracket parents carry. Every operation runs bracketed by markers, and the bracket draws the operation's run window and keeps the op-log entries the operation created (pmxnnvvq). Only creation, recording and removal invocations bracket; undo, redo and non-mutating invocations never do (vwlrqoxk). A registry write is not an operation and is never bracketed, and a landing's `landed` update is partial work inside the recording rather than a second operation beside it (qvkuluyw). Read together those three leave the dependent one bracket to place: the one belonging to the operation being performed, drawn once, over that operation's own window. A dependent that bracketed a second time, bracketed a non-mutating invocation or a registry write, or made the opening of a draft into an operation, would depart from one of the three and criterion 1 would name it.

What the landing parent carries. uvrltuvo fixes the operation the bracket must sit on: `record --from <handle> --to <node>` is the recording `record <path>... --to <id>` already is, reached through a different selection of the edits, creating no node and landing nothing outside an owning change. A bracket placed on a landing is therefore a bracket on that recording, and a bracket on that recording is the one pmxnnvvq requires; a dependent that put the bracket on a second landing, a second verb or a registry write would contradict this parent and qvkuluyw at once.

Readings taken where the dependent's subject pulls against a parent, none of which narrows a criterion. On ysqqrqsp, the path is read as fixed and the working copy that holds it as the thing the dependent may scope: which workspace reads or writes the file is not the file's place, so a scoping clause about it neither relocates the file nor licenses a second one. On vwlrqoxk and qvkuluyw, the set of invocations that bracket is closed by those parents, and the dependent may only say of a given kind of work whether it is inside that set; a clause that added a fourth bracketing invocation, or that bracketed the same operation twice, would be the contradicting element. On uvrltuvo, the landing is read as the recording it names, so the dependent's bracket attaches to that recording and not to a landing of its own invention.

The check enforces only what the six recorded prerequisites state. It does not require the dependent to repeat the marker file's path, to count brackets, to define the trunk, or to decide which change is trunk — that last is left by uvrltuvo to another commitment. It requires that no element the dependent states departs from a place, a window or an operation a prerequisite fixes, and that each recorded edge carries an element of the dependent. It names no element of the dependent, so rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides leaves both criteria intact.
